five_simulated_lenses.finding: Talk uses actual musician and leads to real rehearsal, not a context-editor dead end.
Known current commitments and real promised participation govern remembered outcomes; no invented prior chats.
Counteroffer and bill role derive from standing and contacts; price and poor-show safeguards retain original policy.
Poster choices and fixed main dock remain readable/reachable in four actual sizes; optional long chat/peer material uses existing scroll.
Free conversation/local negotiation remains free, practice pays existing room/day, social consequences settle exactly once with original show and rollback.

limitations: Authored choice-based dialogue, not unrestricted text/AI chat or recorded speech.
First scene pilot has two stable fictional peer bands and three musician topics; it is not a complete authored cast of promoters or a generated music scene.
Chat memories change later dialogue/options; no daily stat reward. Peer advice affects modeled live reception/fatigue, not recorded instrument playing or audio arrangement.
Physical Android and listening not performed; exact-source desktop Godot proof only.
Native new-player opening slot is fully proved; higher-status bill/offer cases use isolated model oracles, not new native screenshots.
